capture: Actual application screenshots; no mocked network responses, fabricated UI, or screenshot editing.

removal.model: FLUX.2 Klein base + fal removal LoRA
removal.method: Real brush input followed by one local GPU removal and a real application PNG export.

screenshots.caption: Paint over the unwanted red mug with the AI Remove brush. This is the real brush selection before processing.
The red mug has been removed by local FLUX.2 Klein inference. The repair remains a separate editable layer above the original.
Layer commands stay in a familiar desktop menu; the original and the generated repair remain separately editable.
File commands and export formats use compact desktop menus rather than filling the workspace with controls.
Live Openverse stock search, with preview, creator and license attribution shown before import.
